Targets sub-surface rope fatigue damage before visible wire breakage occurs.
Uses an existing sheave accelerometer and FFT baseline threshold rather than speed-corrected gear-mesh envelope demodulation.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Detect incipient fatigue damage in a traction rope at the sheave bending zone before visible wire breakage using already available monitoring resources.
